subject: Tri-zone demo: handover plan & proposed windows
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@harmonia.com>, procurement@harmonia.com
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@harmonia.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Tri-zone demo: handover plan & proposed windows

Hi Jane / Oliver / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time earlier. To make the product evaluation smooth across your distributed engineering group, we'd like to propose a small, repeatable demo cadence that covers APAC / EU / US engineers without asking anyone to stay late.

Goal: deliver the same 45-minute technical demo + 15-minute Q&A in overlapping windows for each region, with explicit handover notes so your engineers can pick up where the last session left off.

Can you confirm the following constraints from your side?
- Security: does your team need a hardened environment (VPN / IP allowlist) during the demo or is a recorded segment acceptable?
- Procurement: any blackout times for PO/review calls this week?
- Engineering availability: roughly what 2-hour windows work for APAC and EU teams (we can propose times from our side).

Initial proposal (we can iterate):
- Option A (single-day handoff): 03:30–04:30 PDT (APAC-friendly), 11:30–12:30 PDT (EU overlap with earlier segment), 18:30–19:30 PDT (US-prime).
- Option B (two-day split): APAC / EU day, then US day; fewer handoffs but more calendar slots.

I’ll loop in our SE (Ava) and Solutions on the runbook/recording approach once you confirm availability. Attaching a short prod-reqs doc that you mentioned would be useful to validate requirements.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: harmonia-prod-reqs.pdf (summary of integration points)

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@harmonia.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@harmonia.com>, procurement@harmonia.com, security@harmonia.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 18:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tri-zone demo: handover plan & proposed windows

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear options. A few constraints from our side:
- Engineering (EU): core availability M–F 14:00–18:00 CET (best for deep-dive).
- Engineering (APAC): engineers in Bangalore and Singapore are available 09:00–12:30 IST / SGT; anything after 14:00 SGT is tricky.
- Procurement: prefers vendor calls in 10:00–11:30 PDT during our internal review day (Thu this week is a no-go).
- Security: our security lead (security@harmonia.com) wants the demo recorded and a pre-demo threat model doc; we can do a short allowlist for live testing if needed.

We attached the internal checklist (see attached), can you confirm whether you can run the same demo twice in a rolling handover (APAC -> EU -> US) across a 48-hour window?

If not, we can accept a recorded full run plus a live office-hours session for each region. Also looping Oliver to confirm procurement cadence.

Best,
Jane
Principal Engineer, Harmonia Cloud
jane.doe@harmonia.com

---
Attachment: harmonia-internal-checklist.xlsx (reference only)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Tri-zone demo: handover plan & proposed windows

Ava / Aditya — forwarding Jane's constraints from Harmonia. Key asks: recorded run, short allowlist option, and a rolling handover ideally covering APAC/EU/US without forcing people to join at midnight.

Can you put together a demo plan that meets these goals? High level I was thinking:
- Two live sessions + one recorded segment: live APAC deep-dive (45 + 15 Q), recorded full-run (shared for asynchronous viewing), live US office-hours for procurement/security Qs.
- Runbook: explicit checkpoints (auth flow, latency test, KV cache demo) with timestamps so the EU team can jump to a segment after APAC session.
- Host rotation: SE hosts APAC, AE+SE hosts EU handover via recording, SE hosts US.

Please draft a runbook and propose three concrete calendar slots next week that respect Jane's windows. Add risk mitigations for security review (what we can redact in recording, how we do allowlist).

Thanks — can you have a first draft by EOD tomorrow?
Marcus

P.S. looped Lauren to keep her in the approval loop for any overtime scheduling.

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: jane.doe@harmonia.com, security@harmonia.com, procurement@harmonia.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tri-zone demo: handover plan & proposed windows (draft runbook)

Marcus / team / Harmonia,

Attached is a first-pass runbook (demo-runbook-v2.md) and three concrete slots next week that try to respect the availability Jane shared. High level:
- Slot 1 (Single-day rolling): May 25 — APAC 02:00–03:00 PDT (11:30–12:30 SGT), EU handover via recording 10:00–11:00 PDT (19:00–20:00 CEST viewable), US office hours 18:00–19:00 PDT.
- Slot 2 (Two-day split): May 25 APAC/EU run, May 26 US office-hours.
- Slot 3 (Alternative): May 27 alternate times if procurement needs Thu off.

Security notes: recording will use scrubbing for secrets (we will redact API keys and internal hostnames). If Harmonia needs an allowlist, we can provide a temporary IP range and a short-lived VPN token.

Runbook highlights:
- Checkpoint 1 (00:07): auth & onboarding flow (recorded step-by-step).
- Checkpoint 2 (00:22): latency + throughput demo (live only).
- Checkpoint 3 (00:35): KV cache & stateful walkthrough (live, with replayable snippet).

Attachments: demo-runbook-v2.md (runbook), recorded-scrub-policy.txt.

Can you confirm which slot you prefer and whether procurement wants the office-hours slot limited to PO reviewers only?

Thanks,
Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

Marcus / Ava / team,

Slot 1 looks good for engineering. Procurement wants the US office-hours to be 10:00–11:00 PDT on Tue May 26 (they need to review contracts that morning) — can you move the US office-hours accordingly? Security approves the recorded run subject to the scrub-policy attachment; they also asked for a short threat model slide (we will provide by EOD Mon).

Confirming: well take Slot 1 with the US office-hours moved to Tue May 26 10:00–11:00 PDT. Oliver will be the procurement point and will send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
